225-2645-3430-5873.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-2645-3430-5873.description:
Activate Everglades by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Everglades
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3263-6495-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-6495-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-6495-6871--211.notes:
Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

34-141-5147.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-141-5147.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-1981-2415-4476.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1981-2415-4476.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

5170-6132-6797-7918.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4644-7791-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two Halflings.
4644-7791-7908.description:
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting The Notary Hobbits.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-2897.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-2897.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Gigantoplasm each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-2897.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3188-4017-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-4017-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

803-3490-4659-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
803-3490-4659-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Arcane Adaptation, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-2403-4496-5220.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3175-5617-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

813-2103-7339.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

628-5231-7214.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

372-3378-7095.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3378-7095.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Chakra Meditation and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Chakra Meditation's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Chakra Meditation trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Chakra Meditation and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

372-3227-3563.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3227-3563.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scrivener and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scrivener trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scrivener and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2919-3197-4506.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3197-4506.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-4484-4871-5643-6710.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2438-4484-4871-5643-6710.notablePrerequisites: There are two cards exiled by The Kenriths' Royal Funeral.
2438-4484-4871-5643-6710.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2438-4484-4871-5643-6710.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

3767-3918-4875-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
3767-3918-4875-5527.description:
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2438-4550-5042-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2438-4550-5042-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2060-4893-5140-5640.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Kenrith's ability, targeting any creature you control.
Resolve both Kenrith abilities, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and any creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-4893-5140-5640.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2440-4055-4183-4404.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Corridor Monitor
2440-4055-4183-4404.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor with haste.
When the token Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Corridor Monitor, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Corridor Monitor for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Energy Refractor twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

1228-5231-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-5231-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

575-4319-5147-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-4319-5147-5441.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Granite Witness.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

3565-4424-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one blue card in hand.
3565-4424-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dragon's Eye Savants.
When Dragon's Eye Savants dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Dragon's Eye Savants from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dragon's Eye Savants's power.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants's morph ability by revealing a blue card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.
3565-4424-5256.notes: In order to get infinite mill and self-mill, you will need an anthem effect that boosts Dragon's Eye Savant's power by 1 or more. Otherwise, those results will not be given.

719-1379-1558-4302.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Angel" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1379-1558-4302.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Angels due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers five times.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability from step 1, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

247-2290-4613.notablePrerequisites: Twinblade Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
247-2290-4613.description:
Activate Twinblade Paladin using Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Twinblade Paladin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

905-2178-2418.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Dauthi Trapper.
Dauthi Trapper does not have summoning sickness.
905-2178-2418.description:
Activate Dauthi Trapper by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Dauthi Trapper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

254-301-5147.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
254-301-5147.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}, causing all creatures that enter the battlefield under your control this turn to get an additional +1/+1 counter put on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
Putrid Goblin's persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, triggering First Day of Class, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

425-1673-2232-2459.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax (if applicable).
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Minotaur de Force to your hand and returning any stickers on it to your sticker sheet.
Cast Minotaur de Force by paying {1}{R}.
Minotaur de Force enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Minotaur de Force trigger, getting {TK} and putting an art sticker onto itself.
Goblin Airbrusher triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {1}{R}.
Repeat.

1496-4050-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1} and either {W} or two life.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion, causing it to enter the battlefield, triggering itself and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

803-1558-3263-4338.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Cleric" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1558-3263-4338.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creatures.
The creatures die, triggering Rotlung Reanimator five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead

624-2777-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phantasmal Image, adding one mana of any color.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Repeat.

2058-2073-3698.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Flayer Husk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Flayer Husk enters the battlefield, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Flayer Husk trigger, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Flayer Husk to it.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Flayer Husk.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.
